Abstract
This article documents the public availability of three transcriptome sequences. These genomic resources were developed for the following species: Helianthus anomalus, Helianthus deserticola and Helianthus paradoxus.

Usage notes

snp_table_anomalus

List of SNPs for H.anomalus. Column 1 refers to the reference sequence. Column 2 to the position were the SNP is located. Column 3 and after are the genotypes per individual

snp_table_deserticola

List of SNPs for H.deserticola. Column 1 refers to the reference sequence. Column 2 to the position were the SNP is located. Column 3 and after are the genotypes per individual

IlluminaContaminants

List of possible Illumina adaptor contaminants used in read trimming.

coverage_per_gene_individuals

Coverage (Number of reads aligned) per individuals and per gene.

snp_table_paradoxus

List of SNPs for H.paradoxus. Column 1 refers to the reference sequence. Column 2 to the position were the SNP is located. Column 3 and after are the genotypes per individual
